$comment: BarelySain TikTok V3 frame sequence and cut timing. Durations are a recommendation; see docs/CODEX_MODELING_TIKTOK_BRIEF.md.
intent: A book-me reel. The goal is to demonstrate modeling competence to someone deciding whether to hire, not to tell a story.
narrative: proof -> face -> city -> campaign -> coast -> payoff
rhythm: Open on runway so competence is settled in the first two seconds. Accelerate through DTLA and campaign. Hold the finish.

excluded.agency_digitals: IMG_7195-7209 are 1400x1050 landscape; a 9:16 crop needs a 1.8x upscale and no higher-resolution copies exist anywhere. Excluded by TK.
excluded.apartment_block: IMG_6088-6120 (kitchen, garment bag, phone, window reflections). Reads as content creator rather than model. Excluded by TK.
